items.headline: Iran's Guards declare Hormuz 'closed' after reported tanker mine strikes
items.blurb: On Saturday Iran's IRGC said two supertankers carrying about 2 million barrels each hit mines on an 'unauthorized' route; one caught fire. There is no independent confirmation, and the US says commercial shipping continues. UK maritime monitors logged a record weekly count of ship attacks near the strait.
items.why_matters: Oil rose about 10% WoW into Friday; a fresh leg up on Monday would add to inflation and hike worries and test BTC's $80k floor alongside stocks.

items.headline: BTC holds ~$81k through a quiet weekend; month's gain fades to flat
items.blurb: Bitcoin traded in a narrow band around $81.4k on Saturday and Sunday, above Thursday's ~$79.8k low. It is down about 2.6% WoW, and barely up MoM (under 1%) now that mid-September's lows have dropped out of the comparison.
items.why_matters: Calm weekend trade plus rising leverage means the next move could be sharp; $80k below and ~$84k above are the levels to watch.

items.headline: Full-week ETF tally: outflows about a third of the prior week's
items.blurb: With Friday's IBIT print in, US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $228M over Oct 12–16 versus about $679M the week before; ether ETFs also lost less. CoinShares counted $434M of outflows across global crypto funds. No sessions over the weekend.
items.why_matters: Demand is still not buying the dip, but selling pressure has eased — the floor looks less fragile than a week ago.

items.headline: MSCI adopts screens that could drop crypto-treasury companies
items.blurb: MSCI's new eligibility rules for companies without substantial operating assets take effect at the Nov 30 close, with a final list due Nov 11. Strategy and Metaplanet were among potential deletions in an earlier simulation; their status is unresolved.
items.why_matters: Index removal could force passive selling of treasury-company shares — a slow-burn sentiment risk for BTC into November.

items.headline: Futures still leaning into weakness
items.blurb: CheckOnChain's futures OI vs price scatter stayed in Leveraged Sell-Off as of Oct 17: seven-day open interest up about 3% while price is down about 2%, with funding positive.
items.why_matters: New leverage on a falling price adds liquidation fuel below $80k — and short-squeeze fuel if $84k breaks.
